chunks: My father, my brother, and the group narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, and from others, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali Al-Būfaki, from someone whose name he mentioned, who said: The son of Riďā (Imam Jawād (a.s.)) said:
Those who go to the Ziyārah of my aunt in Qum will be rewarded with Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the tomb of Fāṭimah al-Ma’sūmah in Qum?
ai.summary: Imam al-Riḍā (a.s.) links the spiritual merit of visiting his aunt, Fāṭimah al-Ma’sūmah (a.s.), in Qum directly to the reward of Paradise, establishing her shrine as a pivotal site of devotion in Shia tradition. This hadith underscores the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt in facilitating divine grace, reinforcing the theological importance of Ziyārah as an act of love and remembrance that carries eschatological significance.
